name: anthropic
title: Anthropic
tagline: Claude models, on your own Anthropic API key.
instructions:
1. Sign in at [platform.claude.com](https://platform.claude.com) and open [API keys](https://platform.claude.com/settings/keys).
2. Press **Create Key**, name it, and copy the key it shows (it starts with `sk-ant-`).
3. Paste it here.
